title: Knowledge check: Introduction to Vue Components

questions.prompt: Which approach best matches “Introduction to Vue Components”?
options: Every component should keep a private copy of all props.
Props flow down from parent to child; children emit events to request parent-owned state changes.
Child components should mutate props freely.
Slots can only contain plain text.
questions.answer_key: Props flow down from parent to child; children emit events to request parent-owned state changes.
questions.explanation: This answer addresses Introduction to Vue Components directly. Verify the behavior in a small Vue 3 example and check the runtime requirements in the linked official reference.

questions.prompt: For “Why components are used”, which practice is most reliable?
options: Props flow down from parent to child; children emit events to request parent-owned state changes.
Child components should mutate props freely.
Slots can only contain plain text.
Every component should keep a private copy of all props.
questions.answer_key: Props flow down from parent to child; children emit events to request parent-owned state changes.
questions.explanation: This practice supports the syllabus subtopic “Why components are used”. Check the expected result and a relevant boundary or failure case.

questions.prompt: A learner example for “Introduction to Vue Components” behaves unexpectedly. What should be checked first?
options: Change unrelated files until the page looks correct.
Disable error handling and assume the framework is at fault.
Trust a client-supplied success flag without checking behavior.
Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.explanation: Start with a small reproducible case. Inspect the element, reactive source, Console, and expected result before changing unrelated code.

review_note: Answer keys and explanations are server-side data. Human review required before publication.
